recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-36178 unless the work group later revisits the separate InsuranceProduct/InsurancePlan split from FHIR-24827.
issue_request: FHIR-36178 asked that InsurancePlan leverage the new ExtendedContactDetail datatype, consistent with other directory-style resources; Jira status is Published with Persuasive resolution and R5 application.
initial_application: Commit 276625857dcd2e40ebf6e01ada8cf5e4c0d9b60b explicitly mentions FHIR-36178 and changed the then-current InsurancePlan.contact from a BackboneElement with inline purpose/name/telecom/address children into a single ExtendedContactDetail element.
additional_context: FHIR-24827 later split the old product/plan model into InsuranceProduct plus a narrower InsurancePlan. Current source/fhir.ini lists both insuranceplan and insuranceproduct as active PA resources and maps InsurancePlan.contact to InsuranceProduct.contact.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current InsurancePlan references InsuranceProduct through InsurancePlan.product, and current InsuranceProduct.contact is typed ExtendedContactDetail, preserving the substantive FHIR-36178 behavior after the later split.

related_jiras.note: Applied/Persuasive split of the old InsurancePlan product/plan surface into InsuranceProduct plus a narrower InsurancePlan; it explains why the old contact element now lives on InsuranceProduct.
